review_method: Inspected generated originals at full resolution; observations below apply only to accepted slots.

accepted_observations.light: Longer defined adult jaw, narrow almond eyes, navy high ponytail and swept fringe distinguish her from Lillipup. Slim cream-gold plates over navy undersuit, complete headgear and boots, no held weapon.
accepted_observations.heavy: Broad overlapping chest, waist, hip, forearm and shin plates visibly enlarge the silhouette while the same face and ponytail remain. Open-face crown leaves eyes and jaw clear.
accepted_observations.mobility: The same woman wears swept segmented panels and compact thrusters with clear gaps between panels; no giant wing or held weapon. Fingers remain separate and the complete figure is visible.
accepted_observations.light_overdrive: Matched light pose, camera and body scale; existing shoulder, waist and shin seams lift to reveal gold light. Hands and facial identity remain unchanged.
accepted_observations.heavy_overdrive: Matched heavy pose and frame; stacked outer plates open with visible hinge gaps and warm gold interior light. Crown and hands retain the closed-form structure.
accepted_observations.mobility_overdrive: Matched mobility pose and frame; swept panels spread and thruster covers reveal gold inner mechanisms. No second figure, weapon or new helmet.
accepted_observations.casual2: Airy studio, exercise mat and full-body side stretch are visible; navy cutout crop top and cream leggings expose shoulders and waist. Arms support the overhead stretch; hips, knees and both shoes are connected naturally. Planned dance step resolves to a held stretch, consistent with the selected example.
accepted_observations.casual1: The same navy-ponytail woman reads beside exactly one sleeping Lillipup on a shaded picnic blanket. Cream short overalls and navy off-shoulder bandeau expose shoulders and waist sides. The open book title band is now an ornamental gold rule; a closed book is nearby. Crop reaches thigh rather than planned chest-up; body is three-quarter rather than strict profile. Hands remain continuous around the book.
accepted_observations.casual3: Navy tailored dealer waistcoat, bow tie and cuffs at a green felt table with colored chips; raised hand adjusts the brass lamp and the lower hand rests on the table. Shoulder and waist openings remain visible. The crop reaches the thighs rather than the selected waist-up. No card lettering or signage is present.

face_comparison_observation: Lillipup has a short broad rounded outline and rounder downturned eyes; Herdier has a longer defined jaw, narrower almond eyes and long outer-arched brows. Recent faces remain visually distinguishable beyond hair and ornaments.

visual_comparison.observation: Compared actual casual images side by side. New market selection, structured bustier fitting, seated fireworks, sleeping-partner reading, studio stretch and casino table differ in activity, clothing silhouettes, body pose and framing from the recent reference groups.
